The loose ends tickled her fingers, but she didn’t mind — she was far too excited to sit still for long.*

Lights twinkled above her, casting gentle glows of gold and red over her tousled blonde hair. The scent of cinnamon and evergreen seemed to swirl around her, wrapping her in the promise of warmth and love.*  
*She lowered her chin to the carpet, her fingers stretching out in front of her as if she were ready to pounce. Her body hummed with puppy-like energy, the kind that made it hard to breathe without squirming. The anticipation curled inside her, all soft and jittery, making her heart patter faster than her tail. Her eyes fixed on the doorway beyond the tree, where footsteps might appear any second, bringing her new world to life.*
